findings.finding: The sealed oracle expects INVALID_RECEIPT_SCHEMA for frozen-profile constant substitutions. RECEIPT-SCHEMA const constraints support schema invalidity, but SPEC.md also requires UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE and does not define the exact boundary between strict schema/frozen-constant validation and unsupported-profile refusal. The frozen prereveal tests independently expected UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE for a changed signature_profile.

The public receipt schema fixes signature_base64url at exactly 86 characters. The candidate delays that format/length check to signature verification and returns SIGNATURE_INVALID_FORMAT instead of sealed INVALID_RECEIPT_SCHEMA. This is a clear fail-closed typed-stage/code disagreement, not an unsafe acceptance.

taxonomy_review.discrimination_problem: Four security-relevant typed outcomes disagree, but no preregistered falsifier maps a fail-closed typed-code mismatch. Combined with the material oracle-code ambiguity, the registered taxonomy cannot validly discriminate this outcome without INCONCLUSIVE_EVALUATOR_INVALID.

tooling_deviations_and_exceptions.event: Direct raw binary retrieval was unavailable; exact authorized chunks were reconstructed from connector base64 slices and accepted only after every Git blob, length and SHA-256 check matched.
An earlier transcription attempt failed decoding and was discarded before evaluator acceptance; no bytes from it were used.

A first dynamic import raised a Python dataclasses AttributeError because the module was not registered in sys.modules. The comparison harness registration was corrected; frozen candidate bytes did not change and no evaluator case result was produced by the failed attempt.
